answer: Tie every identity to an anchor stake that stays locked while it acts: one sparrow can watch many nests, but it cannot be in two places at once, and likewise one operator cannot split one stake across a hundred fake agents. Each new identity must post its own refundable bond, so a sybil swarm costs real capital per head; like a vine that needs its own root, each branch pays separately, and slashing burns the bond when collusion is proven.
